english.title: Tether an animal on a highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) tethered

(A)_[a horse]_
(B)_[horses]_
(C)_[an ass]_
(D)_[asses]_
(E)_[a mule]_
(F)_[mules]_
(G)_[swine]_
(H)_[cattle]_

on the highway at **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) so as to suffer or permit

(I)_[that tethered animal]_
(J)_[those tethered animals]_

to be thereon
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72 of the Highway Act 1835.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
tethered a horse / mule / ass / cattle / swine
on any highway
so as to suffer or permit
the tethered animal to be thereon
